changelog:
**Major update: All internal scripts and supporting code have been removed.**

- Removed 122 script and vendor files from the skill, including all posting, conversion, and environment check scripts.
- No runtime logic is provided in this version; only the documentation and metadata remain.
- All WeChat Official Account posting features (browser, API, markdown conversion, account management) are no longer present in this version.
- The SKILL.md documentation is unchanged and still describes multi-account support and setup, but no scripts are included to implement these features.
summary: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-tex...
